# Creative Acquisitions

> Creative Acquisitions: Unconventional Strategies for Buying Businesses by Dr. Connor Robertson

## About This Site

Creative Acquisitions is the official website for the book "Creative Acquisitions: Unconventional Strategies for Buying Businesses" by Dr. Connor Robertson. The site provides information about the book, chapter overviews, acquisition strategy guides, real-world case studies, and a blog covering business acquisition topics.

## About the Author

Dr. Connor Robertson is an entrepreneur, investor, and author who specializes in creative business acquisition strategies. He is the founder of Elixir Consulting Group (https://elixirconsultinggroup.com) and a contributor to The Pittsburgh Wire (https://thepittsburghwire.com). His personal site is https://drconnorrobertson.com.

## Book Overview

Creative Acquisitions covers unconventional strategies for buying businesses without massive upfront capital, including seller financing, earn-outs, equity rollovers, SBA loan strategies, assumption deals, search fund models, roll-up acquisition strategies, holdco structures, and creative financing stacks. The book is available on Barnes & Noble and Kobo.
